name: Szentistván (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and light grey at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Szentistván: a white and blue shield with a figure of Saint Stephen, within a green wreath, below a scroll inscribed SZENTISTVÁN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentistván arms with wreath and scroll
